bio: The bright, contemporary dining room is the quintessence of Italian warmth and the garden terrace is ideal for alfresco dining when the weather is fine. Gianni Caruso allows his Sicilian heritage to run riot in dishes packed with exuberant flavours. He might season tartare of tuna with a delicate blend of ricotta, capers and lemon oil, unless you wouldn’t prefer a generous plate of risotto followed by Taglioni al tartufo… One thing is certain: the chef’s immaculate knowhow and craftsmanship do full justice to Mediterranean produce (the wine list is of the same ilk). Unadulterated pleasure is the name of the game at Basta!...
